headline: Sensex ends volatile session marginally higher while Nifty closes near 25,299 led by realty and smallcaps

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign fund inflows supported market sentiment during early trade.
Lower crude oil prices provided support to equities.
Realty stocks rallied up to 4% during the volatile session.
Smallcap stocks outperformed with Nifty Smallcap 100 gaining for a second straight session.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty ended flat to marginally higher following a volatile trading session.
Page Industries hit a 10% lower circuit after reporting disappointing Q2 financial results.
Alkem Laboratories posted a 12% drop in Q2 net profit to Rs 675 crore and appointed a new CFO.
Roto Pumps surged 14% during the day's market action.
summary: Indian benchmark indices closed marginally higher in a volatile session with Nifty staying above 25,250. Foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices supported early gains across financials, autos, and realty sectors. Stock-specific action was highlighted by a drop in Page Industries and Alkem Laboratories post Q2 results, while Roto Pumps rallied significantly.
